ideas.pitch: Real-time crowdsourced safety mapping and geo-fenced SOS routing for women travelling in urban areas at night.
ideas.problem_statement: Cybersecurity & Digital Safety / Human-Centred Problem Solving
ideas.title: NariSuraksha
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly hits the core WIE theme of empowering women and safety, which appeals strongly to IEEE WIE judges looking for deep social impact rather than generic tech.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered inventory and upcycling marketplace connecting women-led rural self-help groups (SHGs) with fashion brands to reduce textile waste.
ideas.problem_statement: Sustainable Engineering / Empowering Women. Engineering a Sustainable, Intelligent Future
ideas.title: EcoStitch
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines environmental sustainability with grassroots women empowerment, aligning cleanly with the dual primary themes of the hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An AI diagnostic assistant that screens rural maternal health vitals and flags high-risk pregnancy markers in low-connectivity areas.
ideas.title: MatriCare
ideas.why_it_could_win: Healthcare tracking by IEEE CIS (Computational Intelligence Society co-organizer) heavily rewards ML pipelines applied to real physiological datasets.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven digital twin platform for monitoring university campus energy usage and detecting abnormal power drains in real-time.
ideas.problem_statement: Sustainable Engineering / Artificial Intelligence & Emerging Technologies
ideas.title: GridGuardian
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates proven 1st-place digital twin and anomaly detection architecture that has historically won technical hackathons.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision mobile app that detects crop diseases and maps weather-crop vulnerabilities specifically tailored for women farmers managing smallholdings.
ideas.problem_statement: Artificial Intelligence & Emerging Technologies / Empowering Women
ideas.title: AgriShakti
ideas.why_it_could_win: Bridges agricultural technology with female farmer financial independence, a unique angle that hits multiple evaluation criteria simultaneously.
